text:
ops-bot: [ALERT] PROD hosted-api — high 5xx rate detected (severity: page)
ops-bot: Alert rule: High5xxRate / avg(5m) 5xx% = 12% (>3% threshold). Affected: inference-prod cluster (pods: model-*-v2). Pager: eng-oncall. Link: https://grafana.redwood/company/d/hosted-api/5xx-rate

jamal: ack — I'm taking lead. paging rotation notified. jumping into logs now. @sasha if I need to escalate to infra please stand by.

sasha: on backup, digging in. first-pass: CPU on a subset of model nodes is flat, but we have increased request queue depth and some backpressure. seeing repeated 503s from the model service container: `k8s: model-server` with restarts.

patrick: customer impact check: 2% of prod requests 10m ago, now 30% for some tenants. charging customers might see failed completions. @aj can you pull the SLO dashboard?

aj: SLO dashboard up — error budget burn is spiking for the hosted text-gen tenant. we should triage quickly.

jamal: mitigation plan: 1) temporarily route non-critical traffic to smaller model variant (7B-fallback) to reduce load on model-server 2) scale model-server replica count +2 3) enable KV-cache warm on the busiest nodes to reduce token compute. executing steps 1 & 2 now.

sasha: doing scale now: `kubectl scale deployment/model-server-prod --replicas=8 -n inference-prod` — will post status in 30s.

infra-bot: Deployment scaled: model-server-prod -> 8 replicas (by sasha)

jamal: rerouting non-critical customers: updating routing rule. snippet:```json
{"route":{"match":{"tenant_tier":"free|platinum_not_critical"},"model_override":"redwood-7b-fallback"}}
```Applying now.

pagerduty-bot: Escalation: oncall -> sasha (ack required)

sasha: acked. traffic shift looks like it reduced immediate 5xx within 2m for routed tenants. still seeing 503s from a small subset (nodepool m-1).

maria: I'm seeing OOMKilled in kube events for pod model-7-v2-3 on node ip-10.2.4.9 — kernel OOM. Might be noisy neighbors on that host. Recommend cordon + drain & reprovision.

jamal: agreed. marshalling cordon: `kubectl cordon ip-10.2.4.9 && kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` — do it when ready.

sasha: cordoned and drained; new pods scheduled on other nodes, post-rollback 5xx down to ~4% across whole cluster.

patrick: OK primary mitigation done. moving to incident classification: short outage with partial customer impact. Will log incident and create initial ticket.

jamal: logging notes here for post-incident actions: we need to tune the alerting and routing rules — this alert fired as a page at 3% 5xx, which is noisy for transient spikes. propose: change default High5xxRate rule to only page if sustained for 10m OR if percentage >10% in 5m. smaller sustained cases should create a ticket/alert but not page.

aj: +1. also suggest adding a secondary alert for node-level OOM/oom_kill_count that pages immediately (we missed node degradation signal).

maria: suggestion for runbook change: when 5xx hits >10% -> immediate page + fallback routing. 3%-10% sustained >10m -> ticket + paging only if tokenized SLO burn >5%.

jamal: drafting alert rule change (proposed) — please review before I push to prometheus rules:```yaml
- alert: High5xxRate
  expr: (sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=\"hosted-api\",status=~\"5..\"}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=\"hosted-api\"}[5m]))) > 0.10
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: \"High 5xx rate on hosted-api (>10% over 5m)\"

- alert: Elevated5xxTicket
  expr: (sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=\"hosted-api\",status=~\"5..\"}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=\"hosted-api\"}[5m]))) > 0.03
  for: 10m
  labels:
    severity: ticket
  annotations:
    summary: \"Elevated 5xx rate on hosted-api (3-10% sustained)\"
```

sasha: lgtm. also add `kube_pod_container_status_oomkilled_total{namespace=\"inference-prod\"}` alert rule with severity page.

patrick: routing changes: we need to update PagerDuty route mapping so that High5xxRate -> eng-oncall (page) and Elevated5xxTicket -> infra-ticketing (no page). sample route snippet:```json
{"rules":[{"match":{"alert":"High5xxRate"},"pd_service":"prod-critical","action":"page"},{"match":{"alert":"Elevated5xxTicket"},"pd_service":"prod-low","action":"create_incident"}]}
```

aj: I'll open a PR to alert-manager and PD routing repo with the YAML+JSON and request review. tagging owners.

jamal: follow-up tasks assigned: 1) @aj open PRs for rules + dashboards (due EOD) 2) @maria new Grafana panel showing per-node OOMs + burstheatmap (due tomorrow) 3) @patrick update PagerDuty routing and escalation policy, include channel mappings (eng-oncall -> page, eng-sre -> after 2 escalations) 4) @sasha add runbook snippet for routing fallback (due EOD).

maria: will also add a dashboard alert threshold visualization to help oncall decide page vs ticket quickly.

aj: PRs posted: https://git.internal/p/r/alert/521 & https://git.internal/p/r/pd-routing/77 — requesting reviews from @patrick, @maria, @jamal.

patrick: I'll update PD mapping after PR merges. Also propose we add a new escalation rule: page on first two minutes for High5xxRate, escalate to eng-sre after 5 minutes if unresolved. Means we reduce pages for low-volume sustained conditions.

jamal: one more meta: change Slack channel mapping in PD so elevated ticket alerts land in #eng-sre-tickets (not eng-oncall). avoids noise in oncall channel.

sasha: +1. want to schedule a 30m retro tomorrow to lock the thresholds and runbook changes. how about 09:30am PST?

maria: works for me.

jamal: I'll write the incident summary and tag this thread. Good catch everyone. Closing active paging loop — monitoring for 30m then we'll move to follow-up.

infra-bot: Monitoring: no further pageable alerts in the last 15m.

jamal: incident closed for now. Follow-up meeting invite sent. Action items in the PR descriptions. :white_check_mark:

patrick: noted, will coordinate PD schedule + update channel mapping once PR merges.

sasha: final note — we should consider a synthetic traffic guard (canary) for model-serving nodes so we detect degraded nodes before customer impact. filing as backlog item in product/infra board.

aj: added backlog ticket: INFRA-872 (canary for model-serving).

maria: thanks all.

(threads and reactions: :rotating_light: on initial alert, :white_check_mark: on mitigations)
